name: @side-quest/browser-use-security
description: Browser Use Security native product owner: per-target identity, admission manifest, and drift proof for the three signed targets (ADR 0027/0028).

scripts.build:unsigned: xcodebuild -project BrowserUseSecurity.xcodeproj -scheme ApprovalBroker -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/xcode CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test:protocol: xcodebuild -project BrowserUseSecurity.xcodeproj -scheme ApprovalBroker -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/xcode CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test
